name: Docker Buildx Bake
description: GitHub Action to use Docker Buildx Bake as a high-level build command

source.description: Context to build from. Can be either local or a remote bake definition

allow.description: Allow build to access specified resources (e.g., network.host)

no-cache.description: Do not use cache when building the image

pull.description: Always attempt to pull a newer version of the image

set.description: List of targets values to override (eg. targetpattern.key=value)

github-token.description: API token used to authenticate to a Git repository for remote definitions
